name: Alphalete - Decisions and Rules
body:
> Decision · Alphalete · 2026-10-01

Also: `Session Handoff 2026-10-01.md` section 1

# Summary
The standing rules and in-force decisions for all Alphalete work, consolidated from the project guide and the Oct 1 handoff. Read this before touching the site, writing copy or reporting.

# Standing rules
1. **Approval first.** Propose and wait for a clear go. "Check", "just give me the code" or "wait" means change nothing. Pilot on one page before rollout.
2. **Back up and verify** every edit (server backups in `~/_seo_maint/` or `~/tag-backups/`). Undo = byte-exact restore.
3. **No price, phone, "free", warranty, "50 years" or other promises** in copy or metas without the Agency owner's sign-off. Never a phone number in a meta description.
4. **Phones:** never blanket `wp search-replace` a number (two July incidents). The site displays (719) 787-7746 (tracking); do not "fix" header, footer or CTA numbers.
5. **Hands off:** the GBP (Agency owner), `/free-video-inspection/` (door-hanger page), `/pipelining/` and `/free-sewer-inspection/` (Ads landing pages, noindex on purpose). Archive noindex is correct.
6. **URLs:** city pages at root `/{city}/` (decided Aug 11 to 12, do not re-litigate); blogs under `/blog/` (moved Jul 17); service parents under `/services/`. Never change slugs to match a keyphrase; no new redirects without approval.
7. **On-page:** one focus keyphrase per page, in H1, first sentence, body and meta. One owner page per keyword; cannibalization check before new content.
8. **External links:** official sources only (.gov, .edu, EPA, city code, CSU, Colorado Geological Survey, NASSCO). Verify 200 and that the page supports the claim.
9. **Facts:** never invent data or local claims.
10. **Content stays editable in Elementor.** No page-load injection of visible content.
11. **Images match the section.** No digging scenes for trenchless work; featured images use the Alphalete frame and real logo.
12. **Measurement windows:** about 4 weeks before re-editing a changed page.
13. **No paid tools or upgrades** without asking.
14. **No drafts saved in the project folder** unless asked.
15. **Writing:** English replies, no em dashes, no named people, no second person in deliverables; write by role.
16. **Never** copy passwords, tokens or API keys into files.

# Platform decisions in force
- **Rank Math and Yoast stay off.** MetaSync/OTTO (Search Atlas) is the only SEO head (titles, metas, canonicals, schema, sitemap). `rank_math_*` meta is inert. (Jul 31, reconfirmed Aug 4 and Sep 17.)
- OTTO title/meta workflow: edit suggestion, deploy scoped by `url_ids`, flush only that URL's `_transient_otto_*` rows, warm with `?cb=`, purge LiteSpeed per post. Never delete all OTTO transients.
- OTTO hidden modules (keyword lists, hidden FAQ, hidden links) stay OFF on all pages (spam-policy risk, Sep 11).
- `/thank-you/` noindex via X-Robots-Tag mu-plugin; 35 archives stay noindex; 23 junk URLs 301 to `/blog/` (Sep 17).
- Commercial child pages for Colorado Springs and Denver deleted Sep 24 and 301'd to the city pages.
- Duplicate blog merges (Sep 15): expansive-soil into expansive-clay; sewer-line-repair-without-digging into what-is-trenchless.

# Tracking and phone decisions
- DNI = WhatConverts profile 171550 via mu-plugin `alphalete-tracking-pixels.php`. The GHL number pool (Code Snippet #5) stays OFF.
- Schema `telephone` stays +1-719-650-2273 (approved Jul 22). Official NAP number still undecided.

# Content decisions
- Keyword ownership (Sep 25): homepage "trenchless sewer repair"; `/services/` "trenchless pipe repair"; residential page to no-dig / CIPP; commercial hub "commercial sewer line repair"; hydro service page "hydro jetting colorado springs".
- A bellied line needs dig and re-lay; lining does not fix a belly. Hydro jetting interval about every two years (Colorado Springs Utilities).
- Blog FAQs are native Elementor Nested Accordions; snippet #32 runtime FAQ is disabled.
- The Search Atlas DKN (project 40991) is an idea bank only; never "Launch Atlas Agent".

# Measurement decisions
GSC UI is the source of truth; Search Atlas page data is directional. Always filter US only (Philippines traffic is internal). Case study Day 1 = June 1 2026. Junk rankings (home inspection, spore detection, gas line) are excluded.

# GBP and listings
GBP hands off (Agency owner). Citations wait for one official phone and the GBP name decision. The Oct 21 meeting approved SEO Specialist GBP access with limits, but Alphalete Offer posts wait for verification (see [Alphalete - Meeting Notes 2026-10-21](lib:brain-alphalete-meeting-notes-2026-10-21)).
